challenge.better_approach: Looked: a scratch table set (set aside: the proof would stop measuring the live schema); a lock serializing runs (set aside: hides the collision, and the rows still leak). Per-run ids plus cleanup is smallest.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That every uncommitted crossing came through a verb (sail cross/verdict) rather than a close that failed midway: measured only for the three FIXME and one SUPERSEDED crossings I know; the 7cae18f7f9c2 BUILDME crossing's path is unread.
challenge.prior_art: In-house: trees.scratch_leaf already isolates the leaf tables; the shared three tables are what it does not cover. Grepped tickets: none names e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources or test_consolidation_links_to_source_nodes; 149b9a1ab9c4 is the bus.
challenge.real_collision: Possible with 12443bcc113f (another ticket's records do not refuse a crossing): committing own records at the verb is consistent with it; no Law contradicted. Distinction recorded.

answers.falsifier: Two concurrent copies of the librarian proof both green, and zero rows of the run's id left in the three tables.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is a measured defect: the 2026-11-19 akiendell concurrent runs, see cairn/devices/librarian/intention+why.json
answers.how: A hypothesis, not a settled shape: test live but marked as testing. In cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py a run id (token_hex, or CAIRN_LIBRARIAN_TRIALS_RUN_ID when set) is folded into every fixture's content, so node_id_for(content) is unique per run, and into each row's provenance as a testing marker; a finally block removes this run's nodes, embeddings and links (extending _cleanup, which today removes links only). A scratch table set was weighed and set aside: it would stop the proof measuring the live schema. The new proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees_runs_alongside_itself.py runs two copies of the librarian proof at once and counts rows before and after; it declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S above the two-copy wall.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (permanent in records of truth: a crossing that exists on one disk is not permanent); Law 4 (enforced by physics, not by a hand remembering sail step 10); Law 5 (the repo is itself the state of the machine).
answers.what: test_librarian_trees.py mints every node under a per-run id marked as testing, and removes that run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block, so two copies at once do not collide.

bullets.text: Measured: 2026-11-19 on akiendell (Windows): alone, 10 of 10 runs green (76-102 s); inside aa750de17382's moved-proofs tooth 1 red of 4 (the first; teeth e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources and the consolidation-links tooth) then 3 green; Linux (akienasus_cc_0) 40 of 40 green. Two copies at once, 3 rounds: RED 6 of 6 copies (1-2 teeth each): e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources x3, test_source_nodes_in_provenance x3, UniqueViolation cairn_nodes_pkey, UniqueViolation cairn_embeddings_pkey. The proof writes dbname cairn at 127.0.0.1:5432 (store.DB_NAME), this box's own live PostgreSQL 17.9 (x86_64-windows), through trees.NODES_TABLE, EMBEDDINGS_TABLE and LINKS_TABLE; node ids are sha256(content)[:16], so identical fixture content from two runs is the same row. _cleanup (line 329) deletes this run's links only. Observed after the runs, not attributed and not to be deleted here: cairn_nodes 521, cairn_embeddings 476, cairn_links 9, oldest node 2026-10-28. Other proofs whose source holds the 'alpha'/'phantom' strings seen in those rows (unmarked as far as this grep shows; each gets its own ticket): cairn/devices/codemother/machines/{constrain,decompose,hypothesize,survey,triage,validate}/proofs/test_chart_*.py and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py.
